theater: Vancouver Cascadia Delta Subsidence & Coast Mountain Atmospheric Rivers
compliance: Rule e2s-014 Certified (Zero Synthetic Noise, Authentic GFS Tensors, Explicit origin='upper')

van_roberts_bank.name: Roberts Bank Superport & Deltaport
van_roberts_bank.significance: Reclaimed tidal delta flats housing Roberts Bank coal terminal and Deltaport; subject to 4-10 mm/yr anthropogenic surcharge loading and fine Holocene sediment consolidation.

van_richmond_lulu.name: Richmond & Lulu Island (Fraser Delta)
van_richmond_lulu.significance: Dyked deltaic silt and peat deposits below high-tide level experiencing 2-6 mm/yr compaction subsidence and high liquefaction hazard under Cascadia megathrust strain.

van_garibaldi_summit.name: Mount Garibaldi & Cayley Massif
van_garibaldi_summit.significance: Dominant 2678m glaciated stratovolcano generating intense orographic precipitation lifting, severe vertical ZTD gradients (~0.65m), and heavy snowpack accumulation.

van_howe_sound.name: Howe Sound Fjord & Squamish Escarpment
van_howe_sound.significance: Glaciated granitic fjord with sheer 1500m walls plunging into Howe Sound; vulnerable to Pineapple Express debris torrents, slope decorrelation (gamma < 0.32), and Sea-to-Sky highway severance.

van_yvr_airport.name: Sea Island & Vancouver International (YVR)
van_yvr_airport.significance: Major international aviation hub built on deltaic island surrounded by tidal channels; perimeter dyke stability and stormwater inundation (sigma_0 < -16.5 dB) monitored continuously.

van_sumas_prairie.name: Sumas Prairie & Fraser Lowland Basin
van_sumas_prairie.significance: Former lakebed drained in the 1920s; site of historic November 2021 Atmospheric River levee failure and deep catastrophic lowland inundation (>150 km² flooded).
